title: Local launch fixes
summary: More reliable folder launch, fixed card export and corrected emoji URLs.

sections.title: Local app
items: Added instructions and a local server launcher for accounts and on-device saves.
Cards use local backgrounds that export without relying on external images.
Fixed emoji loading in the wheels.

title: The Legends tour
summary: 18 scenario medals, personal records to improve and fixes for previews, archives and saves.

sections.title: A challenge across careers
items: Six scenarios now have Bronze, Silver and Gold medals: 18 feats with increasingly demanding goals.
Every new real Solo career counts, including free careers. Medals stay in your profile; previews, archives and local duels do not award them.
Each scenario shows your next medal and best attempt towards gold, keeping one complete career result.
New medals appear in the final summary. The Tour lives inside Scenarios, with no duplicate section or repeatable XP.
Progress is included in local account saves and backups, merging results and validating imports before applying them.

sections.title: Gameplay fixes
items: Opening the archive during a real career asks before replacing it; spinning or pending-choice states remain protected.
Finished-career previews, rarity animation and narrow-sector badges are now consistent and readable.
Switching from the daily challenge to a scenario or code before the first spin clears the old challenge correctly.
Daily results survive midnight and are removed from demo and archive previews.
Rankings support older saves, and card styles update across tabs on the same profile.
Failed medal reads or saves are reported with a retry option that preserves existing progress.

title: Rarity in colour
summary: Four distinct colours separate common outcomes from rarer ones while keeping the arcade style.

sections.title: More readable wheels
items: Green for common outcomes, blue for uncommon, purple for rare and gold for very rare.
Sectors, legend and odds panel share one rarity classification, grouping repeated outcomes.
Wheels with similar odds retain category colours; colour shows rarity, not the strength of the outcome.
Clearer rims on rare sectors and dark text on gold. Probabilities, sector sizes and outcomes are unchanged.

title: The new Career Wheel arena
summary: A reorganised interface, live career summary, game guide and a review of saves and challenges.

sections.title: A new arena
items: A compact header, focused navigation and a dark stadium with graphite surfaces and mint accents.
A large central wheel keeps its arcade colours; previews and odds are grouped below the controls.
Five stages make the journey clear: origins, club, profile, attributes and honours.
Cards, statistics, lobby, duels and dialogs share a clearer visual hierarchy, including on phones.

sections.title: New tools for playing
items: The live summary shows identity, club, style and drawn values, without inventing an OVR before the final card.
A guide explains spins, modes, saves, duels and Career Points.
In Objectives, the next milestone suggests a nearby achievement with real progress and its XP reward.
The wheel centre can replay a completed career; required event choices are brought into view.
PNG export with feedback, bounded image loading, local fallback backgrounds and compatible Blob downloads.

sections.title: Fixes and checks
items: Older careers without a playing style open and share correctly.
Completed translations for positions, trophies, talents, bonuses and dynamic messages in Italian, English, Spanish and French.
Daily challenges use Normal mode, retain their date across midnight and distinguish the latest attempt from history.
Stricter validation of duel recovery, room results, progress and identity locking.
Account requests have timeouts, imports are validated before changing progress and incoming friendship requests have limits.
Automated checks use isolated data, with screen checks in the local browser.
The local career is restored even when the account service does not respond, before play is re-enabled.
Talent descriptions and the final card use the same bonuses; existing applied balance values are preserved.
Results are announced to screen readers and mode groups remain accessible on phones.

title: More believable careers and a new duel finale
summary: Realistic mode shaped by position and seasons, an animated final comparison and a personal career summary.

sections.title: Realistic mode
items: New Realistic careers use attribute probabilities and an OVR weighted by the player’s position.
Goals and assists are exact counts, with outcomes based on position, seasons played and attributes.
Multiple traits are less frequent; exceptional values remain possible, with lower probabilities.
Trophy counts respect the opportunities available during the career, including competitions held every four years.
Careers already in progress keep their previous rules and the results already obtained.

sections.title: Duel finale
items: Both cards are presented side by side, followed by an attribute and honours comparison.
Career Points count up during the presentation before the winner is revealed using the selected criterion; ties are also recognized.
The presentation can be skipped and respects the reduced motion preference.

sections.title: Your story
items: A personal title captures the character of the career based on its results.
Three highlights use actual career outcomes and accompany the existing story.

title: Arcade colors for the wheel
summary: A brighter palette, with distinct sectors and neutral details.

sections.title: Wheel colors
items: Electric blue, fuchsia, green, cyan, orange and purple for the wheel sectors.
Colors in the probability list follow the new sector palette.
Neutral highlights, a graphite center and a light pointer complete the new look.

title: A more polished wheel
summary: New colors, clearer labels and a more visible result, with the wheel staying large and centered.

sections.title: Wheel appearance and interaction
items: Refreshed palette with blue, turquoise, purple and amber; sector colors match those in the probability list.
Clearer labels, with long names arranged across multiple lines and improved contrast.
The winning sector is highlighted when the spin ends, while the other sectors fade.
A minimal center with a Spin control that also works with a keyboard.
The pointer follows sectors as they pass; animations respect the reduced motion preference.
A gold accent distinguishes the rarest results.
Draw probabilities, accounts and progress are preserved; the update is available on the local server.

title: Let the wheel settle the challenge
summary: A local duel for two players on the same PC: create your careers in turns and compare cards and Career Points.

sections.title: Local duel
items: Added a Duel mode for two players sharing the same PC, with no account required.
Choose a shared career mode and the criterion that decides the winner before starting.
Each player enters a name and shirt number and spins their wheels during their turn.
The final summary compares both cards and the Career Points of both careers.
Equal results are recognized as ties.
Your Solo career and existing progress remain available; development continues on the local server.

title: Online, with your friends
summary: The site can be hosted online with persistent saves and room invitations from Friends.

sections.title: Rooms and progress
items: Online accounts, friendships, saves and rooms use a persistent database.
Saved friends can receive a direct invitation to your private room.
Accept or decline invitations in Friends; invitations expire after 15 minutes.
An accepted invitation opens the lobby with its code already filled in; players still choose their name and shirt number.
Export and import progress in Account to move from the local site to the new address.
Archives and objectives are merged during transfer; a career already started on this device is kept.

title: Your account, your progress, your friends
summary: Accounts and personal saves on the server, with a Friends panel for saved contacts and friend requests.

sections.title: Account
items: Added Account to the top navigation, with sign-in and profile creation using an email, password and nickname.
The account panel lets you change your nickname and sign out.
Creating an account provides a personal recovery code for regaining access and setting a new password.
Recovery uses your personal code and does not require an email delivery service.

sections.title: Personal saves
items: Your current career and archived careers are linked to your account.
Unlocked objectives, XP, level, records and challenge progress are kept with your saves.
Card customizations, profile style, language and the feedback draft follow your account.
Added automatic progress synchronization and a Sync now command in the Account panel.
Guest progress stays separate from registered users’ progress.
Account data is stored on the server hosting the site: on the local server when using the local installation.

sections.title: Friends and navigation
items: Friends now holds your saved friends list and lets you search for other players by nickname.
Friend requests can be accepted or declined; the list distinguishes friends from pending requests.
Added a personal friendship link that you can copy and share so others can find you.
Without an account, the Friends panel invites you to sign in or create a profile.
Challenges shared through a code are grouped under Objectives, avoiding duplicate sections.
Account, saves and Friends are available in Italian, English, Spanish and French.

title: The story of Career Wheel, from the beginning
summary: An update history covering every stage of the project, from the first wheel to missions and the new navigation.

sections.title: News and updates
items: Added the complete Career Wheel changelog, accessible from the site.
The current version and latest update now appear together at the top, with direct access to the release notes.
Each update includes a summary and an organized list of new features and fixes.
Search the history by version or feature to find an update quickly.
The complete history is translated into Italian, English, Spanish and French.
The early stages of development are covered too: cards, wheels, probabilities, animations, missions, events, challenges, rooms and interface.
Older patches are grouped into update series when a precise history for each individual version is unavailable.
Undocumented historical dates are left undated rather than assigned arbitrarily.

title: The wheel in the centre, the tools at the top
summary: A compact navigation bar opens sections in dedicated panels, freeing up space around the wheel.

sections.title: Navigation
items: Added a top bar with Messages, Feedback, Objectives, Rankings, Friends, Archive and Profile.
Existing sections were moved into the new panels, preserving their data and features.
Objectives brings together missions, the daily challenge and special scenarios.
Archive brings together saved careers, the card album and the career tournament.
Profile brings together your level, titles, card backgrounds and OVR guide.
The wheel stays large and central; panels open only when needed.
Navigation and panels are available in Italian, English, Spanish and French.

sections.title: Rankings and friends
items: Rankings for careers saved on the device, sortable by Career Points or OVR.
Access to personal records and the option to reopen a career from the rankings.
The Friends panel brings together private room invitations and shared challenges with codes.
Access to the existing lobby without adding a second room management system.
The profile uses the local progress already recorded in the game.

sections.title: Messages and feedback
items: Messages brings the site's news together in one place.
A Feedback form for reporting a bug or suggesting an idea.
Drafts are saved on the device and can be copied or downloaded as a report.
Reports include the entered message, report type, version, language and creation time.

title: More objectives, a level that matters
summary: There are now 67 missions. Your profile level unlocks titles and backgrounds, while new objectives span multiple careers.

sections.title: 24 new missions
items: Expanded the catalogue from 43 to 67 achievements, preserving all previous missions.
New milestones for completing 1, 3, 10 and 25 real careers.
Cumulative objectives for reaching 1,500 goals and 1,000 assists across recorded careers.
Exploration objectives for playing with 3 different nationalities, leagues, positions and play styles.
Solid Foundation rewards having all six attributes at 70 or above; Score and Create requires at least 300 goals and 200 assists.
A Valuable Career requires at least 300 Career Points; Fair Play requires yellow and red cards in the 0–10 range.
New combinations of goals and shooting, assists and passing, pace and dribbling, defending and physicality, passing and dribbling.
Club and Country, European Dynasty and National Pride reward combinations of trophies.
Trophies Matter rewards a card with an OVR between 75 and 84 and at least 8 trophies.
Natural Talent requires an OVR of at least 85 without special talents.

sections.title: Levels and rewards
items: Your level belongs to your profile, carries over between careers and increases every 500 XP.
Each mission awards its XP only once.
Unlockable titles and card backgrounds: Classic at level 1, Emerald at 3, Sapphire at 6, Gold at 10, Aurora at 15 and Legend at 20.
Profile titles progress through Rookie, Prospect, Star Player, World Class, Icon and Legend.
Your chosen style stays saved and is also included in the PNG card.
The panel shows total XP, XP needed for the next level and the next reward.
Incomplete, Earned and All filters, with Attributes, Career and Trophies, Exploration and Secret categories.
Three missions are visible when the panel opens; the full list expands on request.
New missions, levels and rewards translated into Italian, English, Spanish and French.

sections.title: Progress fixes
items: Missions are awarded only at the end of a real career, after event effects have been applied.
Card previews do not grant XP, levels or newly earned missions.
Reopening a career from the archive does not award XP or objectives again.
Fixed attribute calculations during a partial career, keeping pace, shooting, passing, dribbling, defending and physicality correctly matched.
Record Breaker now requires 900 goals, a result the wheel can reach, while preserving previously earned XP and dates.
Previous mission unlocks and dates are preserved; the archive distinguishes a career's XP from the profile level.

title: A dedicated lobby for online challenges
summary: Solo and Online become separate views: the lobby lets you create or join a room, then move on to the wheel.

sections.title: Lobby and game
items: An Online view with Create and Join tabs, inspired by a game lobby and adapted to Career Wheel.
Lobby name and shirt number fields linked to the footballer's identity.
Join using a room code or invitation link.
Name and number stay locked after the first spin, including in the lobby.
A button to go to the wheel, continue your career and return to the room.
Room status, participant count and the current series round are visible in the game navigation.
Scoring explained in an expandable section.
Lobby labels and controls are available in all four site languages.

title: Identity, stories and new challenges
summary: More ways to create and share a career: card customization, scenarios, code challenges, records and live rooms.

sections.title: Your card and your story
items: Player setup brought together in one panel with name, shirt number and mode.
Optional card customization with an avatar, nickname and signature.
A choice of Silhouette, Captain, Playmaker, Speedster and Baller.
Upload a personal portrait in PNG, JPG or WEBP format, up to 2 MB.
Personal details lock after the first spin and are preserved in saved careers.
A final player story built from the career's actual results, with a button to copy it.
Career Points and a breakdown of their calculation included in the career summary.
Improved image preparation for card and trophy export.

sections.title: Scenarios and shared challenges
items: Six special scenarios: Unstoppable Scorer, The Playmaker, The Captain, National Legend, The Wall and Complete Footballer.
Each scenario has clear conditions checked at the end of the career.
Create a custom challenge based on OVR, goals, assists, trophies or Career Points.
Share a code or link to activate the same challenge among friends.
The same code produces the same random sequence; event choices can change the outcome.
Code challenges use Normal mode for every participant.
Import a challenge, retry it or return to a free career.
Personal records for OVR, goals, assists, trophies and Career Points, updated only by new real careers.

sections.title: Live rooms
items: Private rooms can be opened before starting a career.
Participants' progress and latest wheel result are visible in the room during the game.
Completed careers are submitted to the room automatically.
Choose between a single career and a series of three careers with cumulative scores.
The host opens subsequent rounds and rematches once participants have finished.
Handles provisional rankings, winners, draws, submissions to retry and expired sessions.
Previews and careers reopened from the archive cannot be submitted as a new game.

title: Career Wheel enters the stadium
summary: A football-inspired visual identity with a stadium background, dark panels and warm accents, keeping the wheel as the main feature.

sections.title: Atmosphere and layout
items: Added a dedicated stadium background with a pitch and lighting at the sides.
A new dark palette with translucent panels, subtle borders and gold accents.
Clearer hierarchy for the title, player setup, wheel and tools.
Solo and Online entry points presented as two game modes.
The wheel stays central and retains the requested large size.
Secondary tools and statistics grouped into expandable sections to leave more room for the game.
Adaptations for small screens and reduced-motion preferences.

title: Private rooms and Career Points
summary: The site adopts a tidier version numbering scheme and adds challenges among friends that compare both career achievements and card strength.

sections.title: Tidier version numbering
items: Version numbering moves from the long 1.0 series to 1.1 versions.
The position on the card is centred below the overall OVR.
Name and shirt number are chosen before the game and lock after the first spin.
The identity lock also applies to the name on the final card; Restart lets you choose a new footballer.

sections.title: Scoring and private rooms
items: Create a private room and join using a code or invitation link.
Rooms support up to 10 participants, with rankings of their results.
Three victory criteria: most Career Points, strongest card or combined score.
Career Points calculated from goals, assists, seasons, league titles, Champions League titles, World Cups, continental cups and Ballon d'Or awards.
Goals and assists have different weights depending on the footballer's position.
Each season is worth 2 points; a league title 12, Champions League 22, World Cup 25, continental cup 15 and Ballon d'Or 20.
The card challenge compares participants' OVR with double weight and their six attributes.
Combined mode brings together 70% career score and 30% card duel score, giving trophies value too.
Handles ties in attribute rankings and distinguishes between best career, strongest card and overall winner.
A local server for rooms and shared result updates among participants.

sections.title: Languages
items: Reviewed translations for the interface, wheels, results, summaries, events, archive and challenges.
Language switching in Italian, English, Spanish and French is available in the new sections too.
Improved accessible labels and logo names in the selected language.

title: A more polished card and a clearer game
summary: Reorganized tools and summaries, new personal choices, play styles and an animated card reveal.

sections.title: Interface and summary
items: Reorganized Missions, the daily challenge, album, guide and archive to reduce repeated or scattered sections.
The final summary shows seasons, goals and assists immediately; full statistics and trophies expand on request.
Career highlights brought together in the summary.
Reviewed spacing, alignment, borders and readability across the interface.

sections.title: Identity and card
items: Players choose their shirt number alongside their name instead of having it assigned by the wheel.
Added the play style wheel: Speedster, Finisher, Playmaker, Dribbler, Rock-Solid Defender and Physical Dominator.
Each style adds a bonus of 2 to its attribute and appears in the summary.
An animated card reveal at the end of the career.
The shirt number was moved down to stay inside the card.
OVR and position moved to the left corner and lowered to fit within the card border.

sections.title: Career modes
items: Quick mode with shorter spins, keeping every wheel.
Normal mode for the full experience.
Realistic mode with exceptional results and major trophies appearing less often.
The mode is chosen before starting the career.

title: Site identity and the wheel in the spotlight
summary: A dedicated icon, a simpler wheel centre and a series of layout revisions to bring the large wheel back to the centre.

sections.title: Visual identity
items: Created a dedicated Career Wheel icon for the site's identity.
Revised the wheel centre several times, settling on a minimal element without a football.
The centre covers the wedges beneath it with a single unified shape.
Reviewed site colours and surfaces while keeping the wedges recognizable.

sections.title: Layout and logos
items: Explored different layouts and restored the large, central wheel requested for the game.
Fixed the wheel size when the layout made it too small.
The final card and trophies remain side by side on wide screens and adapt to smaller screens.
Updated the Serie A logo and fixed the case where only a text placeholder appeared.
Reorganized secondary tools to simplify the main screen.

title: Better organized wheels, clearer probabilities
summary: A review of wheel order, rarities and colours, with a preview for moving quickly between categories.

sections.title: Probabilities and order
items: Reviewed probabilities to distinguish common results from exceptional ones.
Made goals and assists easier to obtain, while keeping the highest results rarer.
High attributes, large trophy totals and extreme results retain lower probabilities.
The Probability and Rarity guide shows the actual chances for each spin.
Reordered the wheels into a more coherent journey: origins, position, league and team, career and physique, attributes, statistics and trophies.
Saved careers are adapted to the new question order.
Explore the Wheels lets you choose a wheel or use Previous and Next without changing the career.
Fixed the match between the selected league and the league logo on the final card, including the Bundesliga/La Liga case.

sections.title: Foot, talents and seasons
items: Preferred foot has 9 wedges: 3 Right, 3 Left and 3 Both.
Both-footed wedges are spread among the others and have a lower probability.
The same foot uses the same colour: blue for Right, red for Left and orange for Both.
The talent wheel keeps equal wedges and equally likely outcomes.
Talents already drawn are excluded from subsequent draws in the same career.
The seasons wheel keeps 18 wedges and starts at a minimum of 10 seasons, up to 27.

sections.title: Wedge colours
items: Refreshed wheel colours, keeping colour families tied to their categories.
More distinct shades for attributes, cards and trophies, even within the same category.
Rarity differences are highlighted by a stronger change in shade.
Kept light wheel labels with a dark outline for readability.
Added black borders between wedges to separate results more clearly.

title: Less clutter, more interaction
summary: More compact sections, more vibrant wheels and new events with choices, alongside a tournament between saved careers.

sections.title: Organization and readability
items: Grouped secondary tools into expandable sections to reduce page clutter.
Reviewed wheel palettes and made the wedges more vibrant.
Fixed cases where achievements were announced again as newly earned.
The version is shown centrally, removing the update count.

sections.title: Events and tournaments
items: Choices in career events, with visible effects on attributes.
Decisions between focused training and fitness work, talent and studying the game, records and teamwork, cautious and early returns.
The option to stay at your club or accept a transfer within the same league.
Choices and their effects are recorded in the career summary.
A tournament between 2 and 8 saved careers, with participant selection and a knockout bracket.
Match results influenced by OVR and a random element, with progression through rounds and a final winner.
The current tournament stays saved on the device.

title: Career Wheel is born
summary: The first wheels build the footballer and final card. Logos, saves, languages, missions, animations and daily challenges follow.

sections.title: The foundations of the game
items: A football career generator with wheels for continent, nationality, position, league, club, seasons, height and preferred foot.
Wheels for the number of special talents and individual talents, with effects on attributes.
Six card attributes: pace, finishing, passing, dribbling, defending and strength.
Career statistics for goals, assists, yellow cards and red cards.
Trophies including league titles, Champions League titles, World Cups, continental cups and Ballon d'Or awards.
Buttons to spin, move to the next wheel, restart and share the result.
Removed the provisional profile at the top to give the wheel more space and leave the summary until the end.
An example preview to see the card and trophies without completing the entire career.

sections.title: Card and archive
items: A final card with OVR, position, name, player silhouette and six attributes.
Added the supplied silhouette for the footballer's portrait.
Six card types: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Hero, Icon and Hall of FUT.
OVR calculated as the rounded average of the six attributes, including bonuses.
OVR and card guide: Bronze below 65, Silver 65–74, Gold 75–84, Hero 85–89, Icon 90–94 and Hall of FUT from 95.
Light text on Hero and Hall of FUT cards to preserve readability.
National flag, league logo and team crest grouped together at the bottom of the card.
Linked the team crest to the club actually drawn.
Fixed name placement, position spacing and alignment of card elements.
Download and share the PNG card, including together with the trophies.
A local archive of completed careers, with automatic saving, reopening and removal.
Compare two saved careers, showing their attributes and results side by side.
A card album collecting rarities, nationalities and leagues from saved careers.

sections.title: Missions and entertainment
items: Introduced achievements with progress preserved between careers.
Missions presented as cards with an icon, condition, progress and XP reward.
Expanded the catalogue to 43 objectives covering OVR, attributes, goals, assists, seasons, talents, foot and trophies.
Secret missions for special combinations of attributes and results.
Player level, XP and medal linked to earned missions.
Clickable missions to view their description, progress, reward and date earned.
The list shows only a few missions initially and expands on request, keeping the panel compact.
Removed percentage labels from achievements, retaining progress values and bars.
Fixed achievement panel visibility and notifications.
A career timeline with milestones, results, details and key moments.
Random events for training, scouting, records, injuries and transfers.
A daily challenge with an objective, attempts, best score and a shareable result.
Daily objectives for OVR, goals, Champions League titles, talents, attribute balance and trophy totals.

sections.title: Wheel, languages and stability
items: Random draws with probabilities tied to the wheel and its wedges.
Wheel animation with gradual deceleration before stopping.
The wheel can stop at different points within a wedge, including near its edges, rather than always landing in the centre.
Reviewed interface transitions and movement for smoother animation.
Colours associated with wheel categories, with readable labels.
Flags on nationality wheels and symbols for continents.
Fixed nationality selection after drawing a continent.
A language selector at the top for Italian, English, Spanish and French, with the selected language's flag.
Reviewed layouts, overlapping elements, spacing and behaviour on small screens.
Fixed errors that prevented the site from working after some changes.
Restored the local server in cases of refused connections.
Added the site version to identify updates.
